title: Marshmallows. Role models. Lives changed.
intro: A friendship bracelet. A first jump into the pool. A counselor who shows you a future you hadn’t imagined. Help give LGBTQ+ kids the camp and community they deserve.

heroMedia.alt: Camp staff and campers sharing a joyful, intergenerational moment.

supportMedia.alt: A joyful camp moment made possible by scholarships.

lifeline.heading: A summer can stay with you.
lifeline.body: Some kids come to camp used to being the only queer or trans person in the room. Some face bullying from the very adults who should be looking out for them. At Indigo Point, they find friends like them and grown-ups they can look up to.
bullets: Give kids time to play, try new things, and make friends.
Bring together queer campers, counselors, and leaders across generations.
Help kids see queer thriving in the people around them.

ancestors.heading: Heroes who are like you.
ancestors.body: Many of our staff never knew a trans person when they were kids. At camp, the person who teaches you a song, helps you climb, or introduces you to a favorite band can also be someone whose life helps you imagine your own.
details: Queer adults are part of ordinary, everyday camp life.
Role models become real people kids know and trust.
That sense of possibility can travel home with a camper.

impactTiers.heading: Help get a kid here.
impactTiers.summary: Gifts support scholarships and the people and experiences that make camp possible.

tiers.description: Matches full tuition for the two-week 2027 session.

partnersInJoy.heading: Help camp keep growing.
partnersInJoy.body: Families, foundations, faith communities, and individual donors help make Indigo Point possible. We’d love to talk about how your support can help more kids get here.
bullets: Connect us with your foundation, congregation, or community.
Contact Dan to discuss a larger gift or partnership.

fiscalSponsorship.heading: Giving through Ashrei.
fiscalSponsorship.body: Camp Indigo Point is fiscally sponsored by the Ashrei Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
details: The donation button opens the Ashrei Foundation’s DonorPerfect form for Camp Indigo Point.
Gifts support Camp Indigo Point scholarships and operations. Donation receipts are handled through our fiscal sponsor.
